newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - ELXSI Corp Q2 shr $0.37 vs $0.21.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - ELXSI Corp Q2 shr $0.37 vs $0.21.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTES: A financing transaction entered in 1996 in which ELXSI bought a loan from Bank of America and become the provider of a bridge loan to Azimuth Corp resulted in a net benefit to earnings for the six and three months 197 of $709,000 or $0.15 per share and $491,000 or $0.10 a share. Azimuth refinanced the loan and prepaid all outstanding principal due to ELXSI.

ELXSI recorded a tax provision of $365,000 or $0.08 a share for six-months 1997 and of $256,000 or $0.05 a share for Q2 1997, in accordance with SFAS No 109 using a tax rate that would be in effect if the company assumed an "ownership charge." Management said it implemented measures to prevent such a charge and is hopeful such an event will be avoided.
